name: browser-use
headline: staghorn: Sync Your Claude Code Configs Efficiently
short_description: Sync Claude Code configs and skills from GitHub .  for teams, communities, or across your personal projects. Run evals to verify your guidelines actually work.
author: HartBrook

sections.overview: The staghorn skill is designed to streamline the synchronization of Claude Code configurations and skills directly from GitHub. This automation tool is particularly beneficial for teams, communities, or individual developers managing multiple projects. By running evaluations, users can ensure that their guidelines are effective and functioning as intended, thus enhancing the overall reliability of their workflows. With a moderate implementation time of just 30 minutes, staghorn offers a practical solution for maintaining consistency across various coding environments. One of the key benefits of using staghorn is its ability to save developers time by automating the sync process. Instead of manually updating configurations, teams can focus on more critical tasks, allowing them to allocate their resources more effectively. While the exact time savings are not quantified, the reduction in manual errors and the ability to quickly verify guidelines can lead to significant efficiency gains in the long run. This skill is particularly suited for developers, product managers, and AI practitioners who frequently work with GitHub repositories. By integrating staghorn into their workflows, these professionals can ensure that their projects remain aligned with the latest configurations, thereby improving collaboration and productivity. For instance, a development team working on a large-scale application can use staghorn to keep all team members updated with the latest code practices, reducing discrepancies and enhancing code quality. With an intermediate complexity level, staghorn requires users to have a basic understanding of GitHub and Claude Code. It fits seamlessly into AI-first workflows by automating routine tasks, allowing teams to concentrate on innovation and development. As organizations increasingly adopt AI automation, tools like staghorn will become essential for maintaining streamlined operations and ensuring that AI agents are equipped with the most current skills and configurations.
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/HartBrook/staghorn`
sections.usage:
```
Sync the following Claude Code configurations and skills from GitHub repository [REPO_URL] to my current workspace. Verify the configurations against these guidelines: [GUIDELINES]. Provide a summary of any errors or warnings encountered during the sync process.
```
